description: This file defines a Forecast page component for a weather app using LightningJS. It manages displaying hourly and daily weather forecasts, toggling between modes, rendering lists of forecast items, showing detailed info, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Forecast
classes.description: LightningJS component for displaying weather forecast with list and detail panels.

methods.name: toggleMode
methods.description: Toggle forecast mode between hourly and daily.

methods.name: onListChange
methods.description: Handle list selection change, updating selected index and detail view.

methods.name: onListEnter
methods.description: Handle the 'enter' action on list items, possibly showing a toast message.

methods.name: iconPath
methods.description: Return the asset path for a weather icon based on a token.

methods.name: updateDetail
methods.description: Update the detail panel content based on selected forecast item.
